testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based identifiers on all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Secure Admin Panel at /admin route inside React app (using .js / .jsx file extensions).
Ensure all CRUD operations connect to the FastAPI backend API endpoints and immediately reflect on both admin panel and public site.
Do NOT alter or break existing public marketing site code or styling.
Use lucide-react or @heroicons/react for clear operational icons across all 10 sidebar items and action buttons.
Use sonner for toast notifications on save, create, update, delete, and error events.
Support full quick actions for enquiries: detail drawer, change status dropdown, admin notes, quick call, email, and WhatsApp trigger links.
Include a dynamic Itinerary Builder in Package CRUD (add/edit day-by-day title, details, and activity tags).
Provide responsive mobile drawer for sidebar navigation when viewport width is below lg breakpoint.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Never use dark color gradients; keep solid crisp deep navy backgrounds or clean light slate neutrals.
Never rely on default transparent background on dropdowns or modals — use opaque or high-opacity backdrop blurs.
Ensure explicit hover text color on interactive buttons and menu items.
Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files for all React components in frontend/src.
